title: Dataset of Speech Production in intracranial Electroencephalography (SingleWordProductionDutch-iBIDS)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 10 Dutch-speaking patients with pharmaco-resistant epilepsy who read aloud 100 Dutch words presented one at a time on a laptop screen. Intracranial EEG was recorded simultaneously with the participants' pitch-shifted speech audio, covering 1103 contacts across cortical and subcortical structures. The dataset supports research on speech production and speech decoding for brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: sEEG was acquired with Dixi Medical Microdeep shafts and Micromed SD LTM amplifiers at 1024 Hz, referenced to a common white-matter contact. Audio was recorded with a notebook microphone at 48 kHz and synchronised with neural data and stimuli via LabStreamingLayer. Electrodes were localised with img_pipe by co-registering pre-implant T1 MRI with post-implant CT, and labelled with the Destrieux atlas. Each word was shown for 2 s followed by a 1 s fixation cross.
